headline: Executive order lets the U.S. freeze property of certain people tied to the situation in Nicaragua.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order blocks, or freezes, property and interests in property in the U.S. belonging to certain people found to be contributing to the situation in Nicaragua. Blocking orders like this usually bar Americans from doing business with the named people. No summary was provided, so details on who can be named and why are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: People connected to the situation in Nicaragua who are named under the order
who_it_affects.how: Their property and assets under U.S. control can be frozen.
They would generally be barred from dealing with property of people named under the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 27, 2018; exact effective date not stated in the provided material.
